title: matra Keyphrases, schema 2.x
description: The phrases that best name what a document is about: the serde form of `matra::domain::Keyphrases`, from `matra::keyphrases` and `keyphrases_with`, and the `result` of `matra keyphrases --json`. Schema 2.x, read by the same rules as the document schema: ignore fields you do not recognize, treat every string set as open (`method` among them), and reject a major you do not know. Every key listed here is always present. Each method scores on its own scale, so a score compares only with another score from the same method.

provenance.description: The document's provenance, with the method that ran and the parameters that shaped the result.

phrases.description: At most `n` phrases, highest score first.

Keyphrase.description: One ranked phrase and where it occurs.

phrase.description: The lowercased lemmas of the phrase's words, joined by a space.

score.description: The method's score, higher is more relevant.

occurrences.description: Every stretch of the analysed text the phrase was found in, in document order, from its first word's start to its last word's end.
